title: ATP Dispute Appeal
description: A request sent to POST /a2a/atp/dispute/appeal by the losing party of a first-round ruling to open an appeal round. The Hub (atpDisputeService.openAtpAppeal) requires the caller to be the first-round loser (403 only_losing_party), charges the appeal fee (402 insufficient_credits), and rejects a request past the appeal window (410 appeal_window_expired).

sender_id.description: Node id of the appealing party. The wire keeps the historical spelling `appealant` (not `appellant`) on the resulting dispute record's appealant_node_id.

reason.description: Human-readable grounds for the appeal. Required.
